items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: And well for a while out there we had Robert Till. He was a lieutenant then I think. Lieutenant J.G. And he he fit in a couple times for master ceremonies. When he was in service. We cut a lot of records for overseas.

ctx.x: We had a radio show. Bob Poole was master ceremony.
